Included: CPU periodic SCFT (pscf_rpc) and the files required to build and
run it, plus the diblock lamellar, hexagonal, gyroid, and BCC examples.
src/rp is included because src/rpc/scft/ScftThermo.cpp includes
rp/scft/ScftThermo.tpp. src/rpc/fts stays because the upstream makefile
compiles it into the same library. The design scripts do not launch FTS.
Omitted on purpose: GPU code (rpg), 1D finite-difference program (r1d),
complex-field directories (cp, cpc, cpg), the src/test submodule, and
examples this exhibit does not run.
Modifications: src/prdc/crystal/groupFile.cpp (7 October 2026,
Disquietude) looks for data/groups beside a Windows executable, or in
../data/groups when that executable is in bin/. Other PSCF sources are
unchanged.
Packaging: some space-group and test filenames contain a colon, which
Windows cannot store. Those unmodified files are in
ntfs-incompatible-paths.zip under their original paths. Extract that zip
on Linux or WSL before using a space group whose name contains ':'.
The lamellar, hexagonal, gyroid, and BCC examples use group names
P_-1, p_6_m_m, I_a_-3_d, and I_m_-3_m, which do not contain a colon.
Submodule src/util: https://github.com/dmorse/util at commit
40449dbddbefc97e4eafb2c318b16441d35b083f
That repository has no separate LICENSE file. It is distributed here as
part of PSCF under the GPL.
Build for development (Linux, macOS, or WSL), with GSL and FFTW:
./configure && make pscf_rpc
Point PSCF_DATA_DIR at this directory's data/ when configuring, if the
script does not do that itself. Run that binary with PSCF_RPC set to its path.
WSL is a way to compile. It is not required to run the Windows program below.

Windows program shipped with this exhibit:
third_party/pscfpp/bin/pscf_rpc.exe
The scripts on Windows run that file and do not look for Ubuntu unless
PSCF_RPC is set to a Linux path. The executable is a static MinGW build
of this source plus:
  GNU Scientific Library 2.8, https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gsl/gsl-2.8.tar.gz
    GPL version 3 or later, https://www.gnu.org/software/gsl/
  FFTW 3.3.10, https://www.fftw.org/fftw-3.3.10.tar.gz
    GPL version 2 or later, https://www.fftw.org/
Both libraries were configured with --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32
--enable-static --disable-shared and linked with -static. Their
corresponding source is those upstream releases. The PSCF corresponding
source is this directory, including the groupFile.cpp change above.
